item.title: 2XKO Season 1 release and lengthy update maintenance times revealed
item.description: <p>Although PC players have gotten to play <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2xko/">2XKO</a> for a few months now in early access, console owners will finally have their chance soon.</p> <p>Riot Games has now revealed the exact times of 2XKO's Season 1 launch as well as the lengthy update maintenance downtime that'll happen beforehand come next week.</p>

item.title: Update: All 47 out of 48 confirmed Capcom Cup 12 qualified players
item.description: <p><strong>Update:</strong> This story has been updated with 47 of the 48 Capcom Cup qualified players.</p> <p>The third competitive season for <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is already somehow close to coming to an end already, and it's about time to start looking forward to the big finals.</p> <p>Capcom Cup 12 is coming up in a few months, and most of the 48-player pool has been filled out with only one spot remaining open.</p>

item.title: Top 84 entries in third Street Fighter 6 Art Contest revealed, public voting period is now open
item.description: <p>While <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/alex-teaser-trailer-sf6/">Alex</a> is still a few months away from releasing, Street Fighter 6 is at least trying to do something to keep the community engaged for the game.</p> <p>Capcom has now revealed the top 84 entrants for the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/28/street-fighter-art-contest/">third Street Fighter Art Contest: New Challengers Edition</a>.</p>

item.title: Caitlyn gameplay trailer released for 2XKO Season 1
item.description: <p>After more than six years of waiting since the initial reveal, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2xko/">2XKO</a> is finally about to receive its full launch very soon.</p> <p>Riot Games has now released their gameplay trailer for 2XKO's new Season 1 champion, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/11/2xko-announce/">Caitlyn</a>.</p>
